rom.notes: Recompilación PS2Recomp con el launcher TRG (cnr_launcher.exe, a pantalla completa y pensado para mando): elige región USA (SLUS_214.38, v1.01) o Europa (SLES_543.06, v1.00) y pulsa Play; la primera vez busca imágenes de disco en tu PC (o eliges el archivo), comprueba el ID del disco y lo enlaza en games\<región>\game\disc.iso. No compila nada. El zip trae ambas versiones; la release «packages-v1.0.0» con paquetes por región es solo para desarrolladores. Windows 10/11 x64 con CPU AVX2 y GPU Direct3D 11 (D3D12/Vulkan opcionales). 16:9 real, hasta 4K y 165 fps (120 en PAL), FXAA/SMAA, filtros de TV, texturas de reemplazo, remapeo de mando/teclado, copias de seguridad de partidas y autoactualización. Avisos: a veces se queda en la pantalla de carga (volver al launcher con Back+Start o Esc).

lb.overview:
Much like the DS version, Cartoon Network Racing is a kart racer along the lines of Mario Kart, where players race one of several characters from various Cartoon Network shows (Johnny Bravo, Dexter's Lab, Cow and Chicken, The Powerpuff Girls, I Am Weasel and Courage the Cowardly Dog) and use weapons and power ups to beat opponents.

The major difference here is that the game includes dual riders like Mario Kart Double Dash - one to drive, and one to utilize various weapons. The karts have different stats, and so do the co-drivers, who have various "toon powers" - such as shields, speed boosts, damage output and flying capabilities.

The game includes various modes typical of racing games, such as tournament mode, battle mode and elimination races, with tournament unlocking new drivers and courses, and bonuses such as full episodes from the various shows. The game allows for 2 player multiplayer.
lb.title: https://images.launchbox-app.com/feafe94a-e4e1-41e5-a6fb-6c8d33e8809f.jpg

rom.notes: Patrón instalador: el asset es Setup.exe; ejecútalo a mano desde la carpeta del port, elige tu .iso DESCIFRADA de Ridge Racer (PSP) o la carpeta con PSP_GAME (el BOOT.BIN debe empezar por ELF; uno cifrado se rechaza) y como destino una subcarpeta de la carpeta del port (p. ej. game). Compila el juego en tu PC con el zig/clang incluido, sin más descargas: 20 minutos o más la primera vez. Después se lanza desde el acceso directo que crea (el README no da el nombre del exe); las actualizaciones se instalan desde el propio juego (Options > RECOMP OPTIONS). Solo Windows 10/11, OpenGL 3.3. Beta: resolución múltiplo de 480x272, AA/anisotrópico, más de 60 fps (probado a 144), sonido y música ATRAC3+ completos, mandos SDL2 y Wireless Battle online hasta 8 jugadores con buscador de salas. Según el autor TODO el código lo escribió Claude (Claude Code); proyecto de hobby sin mantenimiento activo.

lb.overview: Ridge Racer is about speed and cool power sliding. The game features a nice selection of 24 tracks, 58 cars and music from all previous RR-games and in all aspects is faithful to the series' spirit. There are many game modes in the game, like a world tour-mode where player competes on the courses in order to earn new cars and tracks, Time Attack where one races around the tracks against time and also a multiplayer mode, which supports the ad-hoc, meaning that up to eight players can race against each other with only one game disc, with one player hosting, and others joining.

rom.notes: Recompilación Xbox XBE Recomp de la versión de Xbox original. Solo Windows x64, Direct3D 12. Ratón 1:1 con menús navegables con ratón, teclado con avisos de teclas en los tutoriales, opciones de pantalla dentro del menú del juego (resolución, modo, límite de FPS, escala de render). Todas las releases son prerelease; las notas se declaran generadas con Claude Code. Probado solo hasta el tutorial del desguace inicial.

lb.overview: In The Incredible Hulk, players can jump anywhere, climb anything and smash everything -- even destroy entire buildings -- as the Hulk, the strongest hero there is! Gamers will create their own Hulk-powered weapons from anything they can rip out of the environment, unlock new moves to battle huge enemies in epic boss fights and experience deep and varied game elements by exploring free-roaming non-mission and side mission gameplay.

rom.notes: Patrón instalador (Wiicompiled): el zip trae MLBPowerPros2008-Setup.exe; ejecútalo a mano desde la carpeta del port, pulsa CHOOSE DISC con tu copia de MLB Power Pros 2008 (Wii, USA RL8E54: ISO, NKit, RVZ, WBFS, WIA, GCZ o CISO) y si pide destino usa una subcarpeta del port (p. ej. game). Comprueba el volcado, extrae, traduce y compila el juego en tu PC (~4,5 min con 12 hilos; ~2,5 GB libres); el ejecutable final es MLBPowerPros2008.exe, con su propio launcher antes de cada sesión (API gráfica, resolución, mods, herramientas). Windows 10/11 x64 con Direct3D 12 o Vulkan. Los tar.gz de Linux/Steam Deck son kits que compilan desde el repo con paquetes de desarrollo (experimental, no se instalan aquí). Beta: menús, partidos (Exhibition), Home Run, Season/League/MLB Life accesibles, audio completo con comentarista, hasta 4 mandos, 16:9 real, FSR 1, interpolación a 120/180 fps, editor de plantillas y texturas. Según el autor, hecho casi por completo con Claude (Claude Code). Launcher y Setup en español e inglés.

lb.overview:
MLB Power Pros is a different take on the MLB license. While the player has the ability to play as authentic players on actual MLB teams, the players are represented by anime characters, with large heads, feet and hands with no arms and legs. The game has been a mainstay in Japan for the last 15 years.

Power Pros does feature options from other real-time games such as Season, Multiplayer and Exhibition modes, it also has a story based mode where the player can create their own character and play up to 20 years, doing activities such as earning the right to move from the minors to the majors, landing big contracts, as well as buying houses and cars, make friends on and off the field, as well as start hobbies and make donations to charities to draw attention to the player.

It also features a Dynasty mode where the player can run a MLB team, trading and releasing with a roster of 40 men and change formations on defense and offense as well as change a pitchers ball speed.

rom.notes: Port nativo construido desde el decomp de Melee (no recompila el binario). Al abrir «GD Melee.exe» (Linux: GD-Melee) el launcher Qt, en inglés o español, pide con «Add disc...» tu imagen .iso de Super Smash Bros. Melee NTSC 1.02 (GALE01); también valen discos mod m-ex como ACE o Akaneia. Nada que compilar. Netplay rollback con códigos de sala y lobby competitivo (Windows y Linux juegan entre sí; ambos deben llevar la misma versión), Direct3D 12 o Vulkan a cualquier escala, mods m-ex y navegador de mods de SSBM Nucleus, 255 trajes, Lua, repeticiones Slippi, modo Envoy (roguelite) y todo desbloqueado por defecto (UCF activado). En Linux el juego es de 32 bits sobre host de 64: hace falta el runtime de 32 bits y el driver Vulkan de 32 bits de la distro. Build de prueba pública con asperezas.

lb.overview: Super Smash Bros. Melee differs from traditional fighting games in that inflicting the most damage does not guarantee victory. Instead, opposing players must force their opponents beyond the boundaries of the stage. Most attacks inflict damage and can, if enough damage is dealt, knock back the enemy. Each character's health is measured by a meter that represents the damage received as a percentage. The higher the percentage value, the farther the player gets knocked back, and the easier they are to knock off the stage. Unlike other games of the same genre, in which moves are entered by button-input combinations, most moves in Super Smash Bros. Melee can be accessed via one-button presses and a joystick direction.

projects.name: Strahlender

rom.notes: Recompilación estática de Pokémon Diamante Brillante / Perla Reluciente (Switch) a código nativo con Vulkan; no es un emulador. Lo que se descarga es un instalador con ventana: al pulsar Jugar por primera vez se abre; elige tu sistema, tu prod.keys, tu XCI del juego (y el NSP de actualización si lo tienes) y sigue los pasos: extrae, genera el código, lo compila (de 10 a 20 minutos con muchos núcleos) y empaqueta el juego. En Linux lo instala en ~/.local/share/strahlender-xnu con el lanzador ~/.local/bin/strahlender-xnu; desde Freeport ≥ 0.2.94, en cuanto existe, Jugar abre directamente el juego. En Linux la compilación necesita paquetes de desarrollo del sistema (clang, cmake, qt6-base, vulkan-headers, sdl3, shaderc, ffmpeg…: el instalador los lista y en CachyOS/Arch se instalan con pacman) y unos 40 GB libres. En Windows lo descarga todo él mismo y deja el juego en %LOCALAPPDATA%\StrahlenderXnu\app. Mods de RomFS/ExeFS y el teclado del sistema de Switch (con tu firmware). Proyecto muy reciente: sin audio en Linux todavía y probado sobre todo en Mac.

projects.wiki: Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl

lb.overview:
Revisit the Sinnoh region and story of Pokémon Diamond Version

Experience the nostalgic story from the Pokémon Diamond Version game in a reimagined adventure, Pokémon Brilliant Diamond, now on the Nintendo Switch system! Adventures in the Pokémon Brilliant Diamond game will take place in the familiar Sinnoh region. Rich in nature and with mighty Mount Coronet at its heart, Sinnoh is a land of many myths passed down through the ages. You’ll choose either Turtwig, Chimchar, or Piplup to be your first partner Pokémon and then set off on your journey to become the Champion of the Pokémon League. Along the way, you’ll run into the mysterious organization Team Galactic, and be able to encounter the Legendary Pokémon Dialga.

Explore the revamped Grand Underground or put on a Super Contest Show

The Underground from the Pokémon Diamond Version game has been powered up and is now called the Grand Underground. Here, you can dig up valuable treasure and Pokémon Fossils, create your own Secret Base, and catch Pokémon in places called Pokémon Hideaways. When you aren’t exploring in the Grand Underground, enter a Super Contest Show! Super Contest Shows are popular events in the Sinnoh region,

rom.notes: Recompilación estática de Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream (Switch) a un programa nativo de Windows; se juega de principio a fin. Al pulsar Jugar se abre su lanzador (TomodachiLauncher.exe): busca solo tu juego base (NSP/NSZ/XCI, 010051F0207B2000), la actualización 1.0.4 opcional y tu prod.keys en Descargas y en las carpetas de los emuladores; también acepta una carpeta ya extraída con exefs/ y romfs/ («OR A DUMP FOLDER», sin claves). Pulsa INSTALL: descarga Python, LLVM, FFmpeg y su runtime (con comprobación SHA-256), traduce y compila el juego (unos 25 minutos) y prepara los shaders (unos 13); después PLAY. Necesita unos 15 GB libres y OpenGL 4.5. Ajustes en el propio lanzador y en el juego con F1 (pantalla completa, hasta 4K, panorámico, 60 fps); importa partidas de tu Switch. Solo Windows: en Linux se abre con la capa de compatibilidad (GE-Proton) y no está probado. Partidas en build/userdata: jugar la 1.0.4 convierte la partida y la 1.0.0 ya no la lee.

lb.overview:
The Tomodachi Life series is back with its first brand new entry in over ten years.

Create your own Mii characters based on yourself, friends, family - anyone! - and watch them live their lives on an island out at sea. Get involved with their relationships and experience all the weird and wonderful ways these Mii characters interact. You may even drop in on their dreams!

rom.notes: Port nativo de Super Mario Odyssey por recompilación estática (basado en LAS Recomp), con Vulkan. Hay AppImage nativa de Linux y zip de Windows. Necesitas tu propia copia en la versión 1.0.0 SIN actualizaciones, extraída como carpetas exefs/ y romfs/ (build id 3ca12dfaaf9c82da). En el primer arranque el propio port pide esa carpeta, copia lo que necesita (unos 6 GB) y compila el código del juego en tu PC (unos minutos, una vez); desde la 0.2.1 además precompila todos los shaders antes de abrir el juego (1-2 minutos; algo más en Steam Deck) y así no hay tirones al entrar en cada reino. Jugable de principio a fin a 60 fps (la lógica va atada a 60), resolución nativa hasta 4K o más, FSR 1, SMAA, interpolación de fotogramas (aún con algún fallo visual), vibración, zona muerta de stick, mandos y teclado reasignables (menú F1/Esc), mods de RomFS en mods/ (no los de código). En Linux sus datos van a ~/.local/share/power-moon-recomp. CPU con AVX2, Vulkan 1.3, 8 GB de RAM (16 recomendados), ~7 GB libres. Hecho con ayuda de IA (Claude) según el autor. Proyecto de una semana: experimental.

lb.overview: Join Mario on a massive, globe-trotting 3D adventure and use his incredible new abilities to collect Moons so you can power up your airship, the Odyssey, and rescue Princess Peach from Bowser's wedding plans! This sandbox-style 3D Mario adventure—the first since 1996's beloved Super Mario 64 and 2002's Nintendo GameCube classic Super Mario Sunshine—is packed with secrets and surprises, and with Mario's new moves like cap throw, cap jump, and capture, you'll have fun and exciting gameplay experiences unlike anything you've enjoyed in a Mario game before. Get ready to be whisked away to strange and amazing places far from the Mushroom Kingdom!

rom.notes: Lanzador y versión modificada de Live & Recompiled (giacomozama y TGP482), nativo en Linux (AppImage, glibc 2.34) y Windows. En el primer arranque eliges tu imagen del disco USA de Conker: Live & Reloaded; el lanzador la extrae y compila el juego en tu PC en unos minutos con el compilador incluido, sin conexión. Mod opcional de descensura. Al actualizar, el lanzador ofrece recompilar el juego si cambió el código; ajustes y partidas se conservan.

lb.overview:
Conker, gaming’s notoriously naughty squirrel, arrives on the Xbox with a bang in an all-new Xbox Live-enabled team-based shooter, Conker: Live and Reloaded.

The game features intense Deathmatch and Campaign story line modes via Xbox Live and System Link, and players can compete as one of six combat specialists across multi-mission campaigns covering Old War and Future War. The warfare promises to deliver the non-stop action, humor, and innuendos Conker is famous for.

Also included is the critically acclaimed single-player game, Conker’s Bad Fur Day, completely recreated for the Xbox with stunning graphics and unparalleled attitude.
lb.title: https://images.launchbox-app.com/90b78dcb-7314-4447-944a-2754d10ee588.png

rom.notes: Build nativa de Linux (AppImage) de Metroid Prime 4: Beyond (versión de Switch 1, program 010019A01E2F2000) sobre el runtime SwitchRecomp de MZ Labs: el código se recompila en tu PC con el GCC incluido y la GPU de Switch se traduce a OpenGL 4.6. En el primer arranque pide tu carpeta con exefs y romfs. Con «Importar NSP/XCI/NSZ» (Freeport ≥ 0.2.97) Freeport extrae base + actualización y deja esa carpeta ya elegida en la pantalla de instalación del port: solo hay que pulsar el botón de instalar. A mano: elige la carpeta (con la actualización que corresponde aplicada; main build ID 8275FBE1…); verifica los 445 archivos del RomFS (26,9 GB) contra su manifiesto, los copia a ~/.local/share/MetroidPrime4Recomp (MP4_RECOMP_HOME para otra carpeta) y compila (unos minutos; ~30 GB libres). Luego Play. Probado por el autor a 60 fps estables en una RX 9070 XT con Mesa; en NVIDIA debería funcionar pero no está probado. Necesita glibc 2.38, SDL2 y, para los vídeos, openh264 o FFmpeg. Partidas en Metroid Prime 4 Beyond_data/save/user/ (se pueden traer de JKSV/Checkpoint). Problemas conocidos: tirones de compilación de shaders la primera vez en cada zona, medio segundo de pausa al cargar partida, el FOV no hace nada aún. Proyecto muy nuevo (repositorio creado el 3-nov-2026, cuenta con un solo proyecto); trae el código fuente, pero es experimental.

rom.notes: Recompilación estática de Fire Emblem: Three Houses derivada de LAS Recomp, con Vulkan. Necesitas tu copia con la actualización 1.2.0 aplicada (exefs y romfs; el setup rechaza la actualización sola sin el juego base) y, si quieres, tus DLC (Pase de expansión, Cindered Shadows) en extracted/dlc/<id de contenido>/romfs. En fe3hrecomp.exe: Settings > Game Files, eliges la carpeta y «Set up game files»: copia los archivos y compila el código del juego en tu PC (unos minutos, una vez). Con «Importar NSP/XCI/NSZ» Freeport extrae base + actualización a la carpeta dump/ del port y lanza el propio asistente del port en modo automático (LARECOMP_LAUNCHER_EXTRACT) bajo tu Wine/Proton; si no terminara, elige dump/ a mano en Set up game files. Todo (partidas, ajustes, cachés) se guarda en la carpeta del programa. Solo Windows por ahora; bajo Proton funciona (el autor lo prueba en Steam Deck). Opciones de resolución interna hasta 200 % y nitidez; problemas conocidos: a algunos efectos de batalla les falta una capa. Al actualizar no hace falta repetir el setup, solo se retraducen los shaders.

lb.overview:
War is coming to the continent of Fódlan.

Here, order is maintained by the Church of Seiros, which hosts the prestigious Officer’s Academy within its headquarters. You are invited to teach one of its three mighty houses, each comprised of students brimming with personality and represented by a royal from one of three territories. As their professor, you must lead your students in their academic lives and in turn-based, tactical RPG battles wrought with strategic, new twists to overcome. Which house, and which path, will you choose?

The game features the refined gameplay the Fire Emblem franchise is known for. Command a party of warriors to move and fight on a grid-based battlefield and, for the first time in the series history, assign battalions of troops to support individual units in battle. As a professor, you are responsible for teaching your students and improving their skills in their academic lives and in battle. These may be school assignments, but the stakes are very real. Your students’ lives depend on your leadership. It’s up to you to guide each of them, so that they may wield a variety of weapons, master the study of magic, and acquire special skills such as horseman
lb.title: https://images.launchbox-app.com/70080a9f-accf-4e6a-8205-b9714d3ac9ff.jpg

rom.notes: Recompilación estática del remake de Ocarina of Time para Nintendo Switch 2, con versión nativa para Linux (AppImage). Se construye en tu PC a partir de tu propia copia de la versión EXACTA: program 0400486024DEC000, actualización v131072, build e0f3ccfa, como archivo .nup o como carpetas romfs y exefs. Al Jugar se abre Hookshot Builder, eliges el .nup (o romfs y exefs) con «Browse», la carpeta de destino (por defecto ~/Games/Hookshot) y el idioma, y pulsas «Build» (10-45 minutos, unos 60 GB libres; descarga sus propias herramientas). Al terminar, «Play»; el juego queda también en el menú de aplicaciones como «Hookshot», y su lanzador tiene «Update». El primer arranque prepara shaders (varios minutos, y otra vez tras cada actualización). Requisitos: CPU con AVX2, glibc 2.35, 16 GB de RAM (usa ~10 GB), Vulkan 1.3 con mesh shaders (RTX 20 o superior, RX 6000 o superior, Intel Arc; sin mesh shaders no funciona), 8 GB de VRAM recomendados. NVIDIA es lo más probado. Experimental: tirones la primera vez en cada zona, árboles flotantes y algunos cuelgues fuera de Kokiri. En Windows: HookshotBuilder.exe.

lb.overview: Discover an adventure for the ages in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, for Nintendo Switch 2. Featuring reimagined visuals, a refreshed soundtrack and modernised gameplay, this classic quest has been remade for a whole new era.

lb.overview:
Ready your wheels for a brand-new Mario Kart game exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system—with a world of interconnected courses to race through
The whole world is your racetrack in this massive evolution of the Mario Kart™ series! The courses you race on are all connected in a seamless world. Drive the paths between them to traverse mountains, forests, cities, and more. Take in the sprawling vistas as you explore at your own pace in Free Roam—or watch how a sudden shift in the weather can mix up a dead heat in a tense Grand Prix.

Ride on rails, jump off walls, skim across water, and more as you race for the finish line. Master these new maneuvers and you might cut down your time to the finish line!

Take on a classic Grand Prix, or go the distance in the Knockout Tour elimination mode

Speed through one course and then drive to the next in a non-stop rally that stretches from one corner of the world to another in the adrenaline-packed Knockout Tour! In this fierce 24-driver mode, racers are steadily eliminated, checkpoint by checkpoint, until only one remains. With Grand Prix and VS Races also supporting up to 24 drivers, the competition has never been tighter!

Race online

rom.notes: Solo Windows (no probado en Wine). HWAoI-Compiler.exe construye el juego a partir de tu .nup. Alfa: los modos distintos de 60 fps aceleran el juego y las resoluciones altas son inestables.

lb.overview:
Age of Imprisonment is set in the ancient past of Hyrule during the Era of Myth, a time period so distant that the veracity of its recorded events are uncertain. It follows Zelda's journey in the past as she meets with her ancestors, Rauru and Sonia, who welcome her to the Ancient Hyrule Castle atop the Great Plateau.

While Zelda learns to control her powers over Time, the Gerudo King Ganondorf attacks, beginning the Imprisoning War documented in the ancient records of the Royal Family of Hyrule. To combat Ganondorf's army of Monsters, Rauru appoints the leaders of the various peoples of Hyrule as Sages, granting each of them a Secret Stone that amplifies their abilities.

rom.notes: Lo que se descarga es el instalador (DKB-Setup): construye el juego a partir de tu volcado. Se juega desde la pantalla de título hasta el primer nivel; muy temprano, puede colgarse. Renderer Vulkan.

lb.overview:
Donkey Kong and His New Partner Pauline Smash, Bash, Climb and Sing Their Way Through a Brand-New 3D Platforming Action Adventure.

Bash through just about anything with the raw power of Donkey Kong! Crash through walls, carve tunnels with your fists, punch straight down into the ground, and even tear off chunks of terrain to swing around and throw – the more you smash, the more secrets you’ll open up to explore.

After saving countless planets from dreadful doom and earning intergalactic mega-celebrity status in the process, Ratchet and Clank have taken some well-deserved R&R - again. Unfortunately for Ratchet, someone else is equally interested in Ratchet's origins: Emperor Percival Tachyon. Perfect Dark: Rare's classic sci-fi tale of firefights and first contact. First released in 2000, it comes to Xbox LIVE Arcade with all its established qualities bolstered by modernized visuals, a higher framerate, and online multiplayer. 

Perfect Dark casts players as Joanna Dark, a secret agent who becomes embroiled in a sinister conspiracy involving aliens and an evil corporation. Gameplay is broken down into missions, each with objectives that must be completed before progressing to the next mission. This is not your typical kill-anything-that-moves game: putting a bullet in the wrong person, not keeping the right one alive, or perforating a seemingly unimportant inanimate object can often result in mission failure.

Next to enhancements already introduced in the Wii version, there are numerous changes over the 2010 release. The basic multiplayer was for instance extended with friends lists, leaderboards, and player invites. Besides the engine change, the graphics have been overhauled, and are typically high-definition revamps. A major addition to is a new single player mode called MI6 OPS. lb.overview:
El Chavo Kart is a kart racing game based on the Latin American TV show 'El Chavo del 8'. The game includes the original voices from the animated series, both in Spanish and Portuguese. The game features 12 characters, 8 Cups, 10 racing tracks, and 7 game modes. The soundtrack contains 11 originally composed songs by the popular Mexican rock band La Gusana Ciega.

In the main Cups mode the player races to unlock new characters, while in the Challenges mode new scenarios and tracks can be unlocked. Tracks have forking paths, traps, obstacles, gaps, jumps, nitro arrows and short flying sections. It is also possible to pick up power-ups along the way. Through local multiplayer up to four players can race against each other. The game features a drifting style similar to Mario Kart games.

SSX is a game in the SSX series of snowboarding titles. A few of the characters from past titles as well as some new ones have teamed up to descend the 9 deadliest mountains. Unfortunately, one of the team members decides he wants all the glory for himself and breaks from the group to make a solo attempt.

Gameplay is similar to other games in the series. You play as a snowboarder navigating your way down a mountain as you strive for fast times and high trick scores. As you perform tricks you acquire points which build up your "Tricky" meter. You can use your Tricky points as boost to increase your speed or you let the meter fill up completely to enter Tricky mode. In Tricky mode, you score more points when performing tricks. In addition to extra points you also have unlimited boost as long as you remain in Tricky Mode.

In addition to the standard Race and Trick modes, a new challenge type introduced is Survival mode. In general, the objective of survival mode is to reach the bottom of the run without dying or in some tracks finish multiple runs of the track without dying. WWE 2K15 is a professional wrestling video game developed by Yuke's and Visual Concepts, and is published by 2K Sports for the PlayStation 3 (PS3), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox 360, Xbox One and Windows PC. It was succeeded by WWE 2K16. It was released on October 28, 2014 in North America and on October 31, 2014 in Europe for last generation consoles and released on November 18, 2014 in North America and on November 21, 2014 in Europe for current generation consoles. It was released on PC on April 28, 2015 and was the first WWE game to be released on the platform since WWE RAW, which was released in 2002. WWE 2K15 is also the first 2K WWE game to be released on PC.[2][3] The cover features John Cena and is the first in the series to use the new WWE logo introduced in late 2014.

The game is based on the professional wrestling promotion WWE and WWE 2K15 serves as the first game in the series to signify the "new generation", placing a heavy emphasis on traditional and more relaxed gameplay, unlike the arcade-like combat prominent in previous installments. lb.overview:
Black takes place in Chechnya (Southern Russia). The protagonist is a black ops soldier named Sergeant First Class Jack Kellar (portrayed by Marty Papazian). Kellar tells most of the story in first-person at an interrogation four days after the events in the story begin.

Kellar is an inadequately disciplined member of a CIA black ops group and a veteran of several conflicts including Guatemala, Colombia, Iran and Croatia. The unknown interrogator (portrayed by Paul Pape) questions Kellar about an arms smuggling and terrorist operation called the Seventh Wave. Seventh Wave have been responsible for a number of terrorist attacks. Kellar is told that, unless he co-operates, he and his actions will be declassified, he will be dishonorably discharged and imprisoned for life. Though initially resistant, Kellar at last agrees to tell his story.

lb.overview:
Ratchet & Clank is a platform/adventure game in a similar vein to the 3D versions of the Rayman, Sonic, Mario, or other games. It involves the two protagonists Ratchet, a furry alien creature, and Clank, a nerdy little robot, going on a quest to find Captain Qwark and ultimately to help save the galaxy.

Ratchet & Clank includes many of the best features of previous similar games, but makes itself unique in a number of ways. Firstly each of the game's levels are huge sweeping vistas with extremely detailed buildings which are visible at all times (i.e. there is no distance fog). This means that a building on the horizon is not just a "backdrop"; in all likelihood Ratchet will be exploring it in a few moments time. lb.overview:
Shadow of Rome is a third-person, action-adventure game with some elements of racing. The game has two types of gameplay: close quarters combat levels involving Agrippa and stealth-based, puzzle-solving adventure levels involving Octavianus. There are also levels in which Agrippa competes in chariot races.

Agrippa uses various gladiator weapons to fight, including swords, maces, spears, among others. Agrippa can use special moves such as "Red Volcano" - a move used to slice enemies in half - to please the crowds. As a result, the crowd will throw down items to help Agrippa. Once a weapon is used enough, it will break, and the player will have to find a new one inside the area.

In Octavianus' levels, the player sneaks around various locations in Rome. Octavianus cannot kill enemies, he can only knock them out. Other ways to pass these levels are by hiding in large pots or by stealing clothes and impersonating someone.

lb.overview:
A thousand years ago there was a city. One day the city was buried. Another city was built on top, and all that remains of the previous city is a door. This is where the title "the thousand-year door" comes from. It's not known what could be behind this door, but everyone has different theories.

Princess Peach finds a map and mails the map and a letter stating that Mario must come. So Mario comes to place called Rogueport where Peach was last seen. There he meets a female goomba named Goombella. Mario shows the map to Goombella. Goombella then takes Mario to her archeology professor. The professor decides to take Mario to the thousand-year door. When Mario stands in front of the door, the map begins to show the locations of stars which open the door. The adventure begins from this point.

Mario can jump, run, hammer, talk to people, etc.. Mario finds many partners on his quest. Battles play out on a stage in front of an audience. In battle, Mario must keep his fans happy by executing action commands (hitting buttons at the right time during his attacks). Occasionally, in battle, the crowd will throw things at Mario. The player can attack the crowd at this time.
